newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Post-holiday trade slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Post-holiday trade slow.

text.p: Several U.S. millfeed dealers said demand was slow to develop after the Thanksgiving holiday week, dealers said.
However, a few dealers reported robust activity Monday at higher prices.
"I'm trading this week and next at $114 quite easily," said a Texas dealer. "Nobody is quibbling about the ($2 higher) price."
Dealers in other areas said feed mixers appeared to be reviewing their inventories before stepping into the market.

Minneapolis dealers said supplies were tight and will likely command higher prices when post-holiday demand develops. Offers Monday at $85 a ton through December were about $1.00 higher from last week.
